label: CMC-Lite Early Phase — Drug Substance Overview
description: Module 3.2.S drug substance overview for an early-phase small molecule program.

inputs.process_description: Five-step convergent synthesis from commercially available starting materials. Key steps include asymmetric reduction (>99% ee), Williamson ether synthesis, and salt formation. Process qualified at 10 kg scale for Phase 1/2 supply.
inputs.characterization_summary: Structure confirmed by ¹H/¹³C NMR, HRMS, single-crystal X-ray diffraction, and FT-IR. Polymorphic screen identified Form I (thermodynamically stable) as the intended commercial form. No evidence of solvates or hydrates under standard conditions.
inputs.specification_summary: Appearance (white to off-white crystalline powder), identification (IR, HPLC-RT), assay (≥98.0% by HPLC), chiral purity (≥99.0% S-enantiomer), related substances (any individual ≤0.15%, total ≤0.5%), residual solvents (ICH Q3C limits), water content (≤0.5% by KF), heavy metals (ICH Q3D).
inputs.analytical_methods: HPLC-UV (assay, related substances, chiral), KF titration (water), ICP-MS (elemental impurities), GC-FID (residual solvents). Methods qualified per ICH Q2(R2).
inputs.reference_standards: Primary reference standard characterized by absolute quantitative NMR. Working standards calibrated against primary. Certificate of analysis available.
inputs.container_closure: Double polyethylene bags within an HDPE drum with tamper-evident seal. Qualified for storing up to 25 kg per container.
inputs.stability_summary: 24-month data at 25°C/60% RH and 6-month data at 40°C/75% RH demonstrate no significant trends in assay, related substances, or physical properties. Proposed retest period: 24 months when stored at 15-25°C protected from light.
